selectionEntries.name: Roaming Performers

rules.name: Roaming Performers
rules.description:
You may add one of the following Harlequins units to your Army List:
● TROUPE MASTER
● SHADOWSEER
and one of either:
● LIGHT TROUPE
● DARK TROUPE
● TWILIGHT TROUPE
If you do add one or more of those units to your Army List, your Army Rules gains Mocking Misstep, Allegro Advance, Prismatic Pirouette and Kaleidoscopic Cavalcade.

selectionEntries.comment: ROAMING PERFORMERS: always-present configuration, defaulting to Not Included. Selecting Included reveals Drukhari-local generated copies of the eligible Harlequin units under Roaming Leader and Roaming Troop.

rules.description:
This unit must attach to one of:
1) LIGHT TROUPE
2) DARK TROUPE
3) TWILIGHT TROUPE

selectionEntries.comment: ROAMING PERFORMERS LOCAL COPY: generated locally for the Drukhari catalogue. This is not a runtime link to the Harlequins catalogue. It retains the Harlequin unit's own points, attachment mechanics and list-building loadout presentation. PHASE 0.1 WARGEAR: decision-oriented V5 grammar. Mandatory loadout choices are rendered as visually separated exclusivity islands with the first source option selected by default. Fixed mandatory equipment is preselected. Optional paid wargear is unit-level and unselected by default. No weapon profiles are included.

selectionEntries.name: Light Troupe
selectionEntries.comment: ROAMING PERFORMERS LOCAL COPY: generated locally for the Drukhari catalogue. This is not a runtime link to the Harlequins catalogue. It retains the Harlequin unit's own points, attachment mechanics and list-building loadout presentation. PHASE 0.1 LOADOUT PROTOTYPE V4: decision-oriented display. Models 1-3 are consolidated into one baseline loadout block; its melee selection applies to all three baseline models together. Models 4-5 remain separate under Special Weapon Loadouts to expose the two-model pistol replacement allowance. Paid grenade wargear remains unit-level max 1. First option in mandatory choice groups is selected by default.
